//lastChange: Added server/config/version.js — the deployed commit SHA, now returned by /api/health and /api/live — with 7 tests over the .git HEAD parsing (2026-09-06). Only resolveHead is tested: the rest of the module is a try/catch around a file read that is allowed to fail, while resolveHead has branches and fails SILENTLY, reporting no commit at all in a way that reads like an older deploy. The packed-refs case is the one that matters, because a fresh clone on a deploy box often has no loose refs and a resolver that only reads .git/refs/heads/<branch> then works on every developer machine and returns null on every server. GOLDEN-006 caught the first attempt: the word it forbids inside /api/live appeared in a COMMENT I had written there, and the route is matched as text. The comment was reworded rather than the test loosened.
